answers.question: What research question does each paper ask; is each claim associational or predictive; and what cohort scope does each claim have?
answers.gold: abraham2017: question "we demonstrate the feasibility of inter-site classification of neuropsychiatric status"; claim "Good choices of methods for the various steps of the pipeline lead to 67% prediction accuracy on the full ABIDE data" is predictive (Out-of-sample diagnosis prediction, N=871 after visual QC, inter- and intra-site CV); abraham2017: question "we demonstrate the feasibility of inter-site classification of neuropsychiatric status"; claim "the definition of functional brain areas is of paramount importance for biomarker discovery" is predictive (Comparison of atlas choices within the prediction pipeline); abraham2017: question "we demonstrate the feasibility of inter-site classification of neuropsychiatric status"; claim "prediction accuracy improves as we include more subjects" is predictive (Learning curves over training-set size); dimartino2014: question "To understand the relative contributions of hypo and hyperconnectivity in ASD, we carried out whole-brain iFC analyses"; claim "both were detected, though hypoconnectivity dominated, particularly for cortico-cortical and interhemispheric functional connectivity" is associational (Group difference (ASD vs TC) in 763 males, 17 sites; covariates age, FIQ, site, mean FD; FDR q<0.05)
